title: The scenario catalogue
description: The shape of catalog/catalog.json: one entry per scenario. It is validated by scripts/check-scenarios.mjs, which reads this file and enforces the keywords used here.

id.description: Permanent once shipped: FAMILY-number, as in .zazz/project/scenario-catalog.md.

scanner.description: The kind of tool that must report it.

service.description: The workspace that carries the weakness.

surface.description: Where the operation is reached: a GraphQL field, a REST route, a process-wide setting, or a dependency version.

operation.description: The vulnerable operation: its signature, its route, or the setting's name.

source.description: The file that carries the weakness. For a dependency, the manifest that declares its version.

flow.description: From where the input enters to where it does its damage.

safeControl.description: A protected counterpart: the file of an operation that receives the identical payload and stays inert.

safeControls.description: Further protected counterparts, one per technique.

hardenedValue.description: For a process-wide setting, which has no counterpart: the value that closes the weakness.

test.description: The test that proves the exploit and the counterparts inert.
